Q5227.reason: Under UCC 2-328(3), goods offered at an auction without reserve cannot be withdrawn once a bid has been made, so the woman can enforce the sale.

Q6156.reason: The company's attorney took the deposition, so the company had opportunity and a similar motive to cross-examine, which makes it admissible as former testimony under FRE 804(b)(1).
